d: Pakistan's Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb confirmed that his nation had secured 3 billion dollars through the launch of a Eurobond and was in a comfortable position on its external accounts. He said that Islamabad received a 3 billion dollars rollover from the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This comes after the U.S. declined to entertain Pakistan's request for a 10-billion-dollar Liquidity Support Programme. Downplaying U.S. move, Aurangzeb said, with or without the10 billion dollar from USA, we are in a comfortable position with regard to our external accounts.
